claims.text: GDACS's flood event report (GLIDE FL-2026-000136-CHN, eventid 1104051) assessed an overall Red alert for flooding in Jilin Province, China, covering a 25-31 July 2026 window, citing official figures of 10 deaths and 809,145 people displaced across affected areas.

Re-checked 2 August 2026: GDACS's flood event report (FL 1104051, GLIDE FL-2026-000136-CHN) still shows the 25-31 July 2026 window as the latest, with no newer episode published; the 10 deaths and approximately 809,145 displaced figures are unchanged, and no allowlisted source has declared the event resolved.

Re-checked 5 August 2026: GDACS's report for this same event (FL 1104051, GLIDE FL-2026-000136-CHN) now shows a newer episode 5, "Overall Red Flood in China from 25 Jul 2026 01:00 UTC to 02 Aug 2026 01:00 UTC," citing local media reports of flooding in Shaanxi Province. The officially cited figures are 10 deaths and 830,303 displaced (up from 809,145 in the prior 25-31 July window), and no allowlisted source has declared the event resolved.

Re-confirmed by direct fetch on 6 August 2026: GDACS's event report (FL 1104051, GLIDE FL-2026-000136-CHN) still shows episode 5 (window 25 Jul-2 Aug 2026) as the latest, with 'Death: 10' and 'Displaced: 830303' unchanged; no episode 6 or newer date window has been published.

Re-checked 7 August 2026: GDACS's event report (FL 1104051) now shows its reporting window extended to 25 Jul-7 Aug 2026, with the cited figures unchanged at 10 deaths and about 830,303 displaced; no new episode or revised casualty/displacement total has been published.

description: Heavy rainfall in late July 2026 triggered severe flooding across Jilin Province in northeastern China, prompting large-scale evacuations. GDACS assessed the event as an overall Red alert, its highest severity tier, citing 10 deaths and about 809,145 people displaced as of the close of its initial reporting window on 31 July 2026. GDACS's report for this event (GDACS ID FL 1104051, GLIDE FL-2026-000136-CHN) has since been updated as the underlying rain system affected further Chinese provinces in sequence (Gansu, Sichuan and, most recently, Shaanxi, alongside continued flood response in Jilin and Heilongjiang) — the reporting window now runs through 2 August 2026, with the official displaced figure revised up to about 830,303 while the death toll remains 10. No allowlisted source has declared the event resolved.
